content:
Hi everyone,
We present PastaLean, a library to verify Python by deterministically transpiling to Lean via Python's AST. Hence the name(Py + AST + Lean = pastalean). This was built by me, @Siddhartha Gadgil and @Petros Markopoulos this year.

The idea is that, LLMs use a lot of Python to code, yet we want to verify if that code is correct or not. Instead of asking a LLM to convert to Lean, we convert the python in Lean programatically. This library does not prove the theorems and depend on agents/human to prove it. Note that this is not FFI either.

Python is a dynamically typed Object oriented programming language meanwhile Lean is statically Typed functional programming language and hence design choices in order to model Python's behavior has been taken.

We also have made TypeInfer, a python Type Inference engine (and very soon type checker too). This outperforms most python tools today used for type inference and checking, not only in correctness and scale of inference within 1 file, but also fastest. (More details and caveats in the paper below).

The project is still under development on improving verification of more and more Python(including Library usages). Since most people use Coding agents, we also make it accessible via an MCP server.
